decisions.reason: As a recent launch close to the core dairy range and already publicly validated by an award, it is the kind of product management is very likely to continue backing.
Because it builds directly on the established cheese business and was visible on the home page, management has made a public commitment that encourages continuation.
This semi-hard cheese wheel fits the firm's existing competencies and, with no clear negative signal reported, disappointing early sales could easily be treated as temporary.
A spicy cheese line with several models implies broader resource commitment and shelf-positioning effort, which under escalation of commitment makes withdrawal unlikely so soon after launch.
The mild creamy soft cheese remains close to the firm's core offer, and management of a German organic dairy would usually give such a new extension more time before admitting failure.

Although a washed-rind soft cheese is somewhat more niche, it still relies on the firm's cheese capabilities and the recent investment and public listing make near-term withdrawal relatively unlikely.
